verses.original: בֵּל֙ כָּרַ֥ע נְב֔וֹ הָיוּ֙ קֹרֵ֣ס עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֔ם לַחַיָּ֖ה וְלַבְּהֵמָ֑ה נְשֻׂאֹתֵיכֶ֣ם עֲמוּס֔וֹת מַשָּׂ֖א לַעֲיֵפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bêl kā·ra‘ nə·ḇōw hā·yū qō·rês ‘ă·ṣab·bê·hem la·ḥay·yāh wə·lab·bə·hê·māh nə·śu·’ō·ṯê·ḵem ‘ă·mū·sō·wṯ maś·śā la·‘ă·yê·p̄āh
verses.literal: Bel crouches Nebo . . . cowers Their idols [weigh down] beasts and cattle The images you carry are burdensome a load to the weary [animal]

verses.original: קָרְס֤וּ כָֽרְעוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו לֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ מַלֵּ֣ט מַשָּׂ֑א וְנַפְשָׁ֖ם הָלָֽכָה׃ס בַּשְּׁבִ֥י
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·sū ḵā·rə·‘ū yaḥ·dāw lō yā·ḵə·lū mal·lêṭ maś·śā wə·nap̄·šām hā·lā·ḵāh baš·šə·ḇî
verses.literal: The gods cower they crouch together vvv unable to relieve the burden but they themselves go into captivity

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ אֵלַי֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְכָל־ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַֽעֲמֻסִים֙ מִנִּי־ בֶ֔טֶן הַנְּשֻׂאִ֖ים מִנִּי־ רָֽחַם׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’ê·lay bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ḵāl šə·’ê·rîṯ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ha·‘ă·mu·sîm min·nî- ḇe·ṭen han·nə·śu·’îm min·nî- rā·ḥam
verses.literal: Listen to Me O house of Jacob all the remnant of the house of Israel who have been sustained from the womb carried along since birth

verses.original: וְעַד־ זִקְנָה֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא אֲנִ֣י אֶסְבֹּ֑ל וְעַד־ שֵיבָ֖ה אֲנִ֤י עָשִׂ֙יתִי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶשָּׂ֔א וַאֲנִ֥י אֶסְבֹּ֖ל וַאֲמַלֵּֽט׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘aḏ- ziq·nāh ’ă·nî hū ’ă·nî ’es·bōl wə·‘aḏ- šē·ḇå̄h ’ă·nî ‘ā·śî·ṯî wa·’ă·nî ’eś·śā wa·’ă·nî ’es·bōl wa·’ă·mal·lêṭ
verses.literal: Even to your old age I will be the same and I will bear you up when you turn gray I have made you and I will carry you I will sustain you and deliver you
To whom will you liken Me or count Me equal To whom will you compare Me that we should be alike

verses.original: הַזָּלִ֤ים מִכִּ֔יס זָהָב֙ יִשְׁקֹ֑לוּ וְכֶ֖סֶף בַּקָּנֶ֣ה יִשְׂכְּר֤וּ צוֹרֵף֙ וְיַעֲשֵׂ֣הוּ אֵ֔ל יִסְגְּד֖וּ אַף־ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zā·lîm mik·kîs zā·hāḇ yiš·qō·lū wə·ḵe·sep̄ baq·qā·neh yiś·kə·rū ṣō·w·rêp̄ wə·ya·‘ă·śê·hū ’êl yis·gə·ḏū ’ap̄- yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū
verses.literal: They pour out their bags of gold and weigh out silver on scales they hire a goldsmith to fashion it into a god so they can bow down and worship

verses.original: יִ֠שָּׂאֻהוּ עַל־ כָּתֵ֨ף יִסְבְּלֻ֜הוּ וְיַנִּיחֻ֤הוּ תַחְתָּיו֙ וְיַֽעֲמֹ֔ד לֹ֣א יָמִ֑ישׁ אַף־ מִמְּקוֹמ֖וֹ יִצְעַ֤ק אֵלָיו֙ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֔ה יוֹשִׁיעֶֽנּוּ׃ס לֹ֥א מִצָּרָת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā·’u·hū ‘al- kā·ṯêp̄ yis·bə·lu·hū wə·yan·nî·ḥu·hū ṯaḥ·tāw wə·ya·‘ă·mōḏ lō yā·mîš ’ap̄- mim·mə·qō·w·mōw yiṣ·‘aq ’ê·lāw wə·lō ya·‘ă·neh yō·wō·šî·‘en·nū lō miṣ·ṣā·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: They lift it to their shoulder and carry it along they set it in its place and there it stands not budging from that spot They cry out to it but it does not answer it saves no one from his troubles

verses.original: זִכְרוּ־ זֹ֖את וְהִתְאֹשָׁ֑שׁוּ הָשִׁ֥יבוּ עַל־ לֵֽב׃ פוֹשְׁעִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: ziḵ·rū- zōṯ wə·hiṯ·’ō·šā·šū hā·šî·ḇū ‘al- lêḇ p̄ō·wō·šə·‘îm
verses.literal: Remember this and be brave take it to heart you transgressors

verses.original: זִכְר֥וּ רִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת מֵעוֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֥י אֵל֙ וְאֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְאֶ֥פֶס כָּמֽוֹנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ziḵ·rū ri·šō·nō·wṯ mê·‘ō·w·lām kî ’ā·nō·ḵî ’êl wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’e·p̄es kā·mō·w·nî
verses.literal: Remember what happened long ago for I am God and there is no other I am God and [there is] none like Me

verses.original: מַגִּ֤יד אַחֲרִ֔ית מֵֽרֵאשִׁית֙ וּמִקֶּ֖דֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ נַעֲשׂ֑וּ אֹמֵר֙ עֲצָתִ֣י תָק֔וּם וְכָל־ חֶפְצִ֖י אֶעֱשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: mag·gîḏ ’a·ḥă·rîṯ mê·rê·šîṯ ū·miq·qe·ḏem ’ă·šer lō- na·‘ă·śū ’ō·mêr ‘ă·ṣā·ṯî ṯā·qūm wə·ḵāl ḥep̄·ṣî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh
verses.literal: I declare the end from the beginning and from ancient times what is still to come I say My purpose will stand and all My good pleasure I will accomplish

verses.original: קֹרֵ֤א עַ֔יִט מִמִּזְרָח֙ אִ֣ישׁ עֲצָתוֹ מֶרְחָ֖ק מֵאֶ֥רֶץ אַף־ דִּבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ אַף־ אֲבִיאֶ֔נָּה יָצַ֖רְתִּי אַף־ אֶעֱשֶֽׂנָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: qō·rê ‘a·yiṭ mim·miz·rāḥ ’îš ʿă·ṣå̄·ṯō mer·ḥāq mê·’e·reṣ ’ap̄- dib·bar·tî ’ap̄- ’ă·ḇî·’en·nāh yā·ṣar·tî ’ap̄- ’e·‘ĕ·śen·nāh
verses.literal: I summon a bird of prey from the east a man for My purpose from a far-off land Truly I have spoken and truly I will bring it to pass I have planned it and I will surely do it

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ אֵלַ֖י אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֑ב הָרְחוֹקִ֖ים מִצְּדָקָֽה׃
verses.literal: Listen to Me you stubborn people far removed from righteousness

verses.original: צִדְקָתִי֙ קֵרַ֤בְתִּי לֹ֣א תִרְחָ֔ק וּתְשׁוּעָתִ֖י לֹ֣א תְאַחֵ֑ר וְנָתַתִּ֤י תְּשׁוּעָ֔ה בְצִיּוֹן֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּפְאַרְתִּֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî qê·raḇ·tî lō ṯir·ḥāq ū·ṯə·šū·‘ā·ṯî lō ṯə·’a·ḥêr wə·nā·ṯat·tî tə·šū·‘āh ḇə·ṣî·yō·wn lə·yiś·rā·’êl tip̄·’ar·tî
verses.literal: I am bringing My righteousness near it is not far away and My salvation will not be delayed I will grant salvation to Zion [and adorn] Israel with My splendor
